summary: Defines a MIB extension to the GBOND-MIB module with objects for managing multi-pair bonded xDSL interfaces that use Time-Division Inverse Multiplexing, as described in the ITU-T recommendation. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: This adds more dials for bundles of phone wires where the data is split up by taking turns, so network managers can check and set them.
